title: Approximate tangent planes along Lipschitz maps: Y has approximate tangent space DF(u)(ℝ^k) at F(u) for a.e. regular u ∈ F⁻¹(Y)
statement:
Let P, k ∈ ℕ with k ≥ 1, let F : ℝ^k → ℝ^P be Lipschitz (LipschitzWith K F), and let Y ⊆ ℝ^P be Borel with H^k(Y ∩ C) < ∞ for every compact C, where H^k = μHE[k].
Then for Lebesgue-a.e. u ∈ ℝ^k the following holds: if F(u) ∈ Y, F is differentiable at u and DF(u) is injective, then Y has approximate tangent space DF(u)(ℝ^k) at F(u). That is, HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt k Y (F u) (LinearMap.range (fderiv ℝ F u)) in the sense of SimonGMT (Simon Ch. 3, 1.4).
lean_statement: ∀ (P k : ℕ) (F : Euclid k → Euclid P) (Y : Set (Euclid P)) (K : NNReal), 0 < k → LipschitzWith K F → MeasurableSet Y → (∀ C : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact C → μHE[k] (Y ∩ C) ≠ ∞) → ∀ᵐ u ∂(volume : Measure (Euclid k)), F u ∈ Y → DifferentiableAt ℝ F u → Function.Injective (fderiv ℝ F u) → HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt k Y (F u) (LinearMap.range (fderiv ℝ F u : Euclid k →ₗ[ℝ] Euclid P))
